decisions.statement: A data file is kept byte for byte as the capture handed the bytes over.
A data file has one whole JSON document rather than a piece of a document.
A data file has raw bytes that no page has yet been written for.
The rows a data file has are being modelled as the reading's own entries.
A data file goes once a reader can build the whole reading from those entries.

definition: the bytes one whole reading was written as
